previousStories.title: Server-side auth rate limiting via Supabase
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side rate limiting on auth endpoints so that brute force attacks are blocked even if the client is bypassed.
acceptanceCriteria: New SQL migration creates auth_rate_limits table: ip_address, attempt_count, window_start, locked_until
New edge function POST /auth/check-rate-limit called before client auth attempts
Rate limit: 10 attempts per 15-minute window per IP
After limit exceeded, 5-minute lockout enforced
iOS app calls rate limit check before each auth attempt
Rate limit headers returned: X-Auth-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Auth-RateLimit-Reset
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: auth_rate_limits DB table. Edge function POST /auth/check-rate-limit with 10 attempts per 15min window, 5min lockout. iOS calls before each auth attempt. Rate limit headers returned.

previousStories.title: Webhook replay attack prevention
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need RevenueCat webhook requests validated for freshness to prevent replay attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: revenuecat-webhook.ts validates X-RevenueCat-Request-Timestamp header
Requests older than 5 minutes are rejected with 403
Rejected replay attempts logged with structured logging including IP and timestamp
Test coverage added for replay attack rejection
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: Validates X-RevenueCat-Request-Timestamp header. Rejects requests older than 5 minutes with 403. Logs rejected replay attempts with IP and timestamp.

previousStories.title: HSTS and additional security headers for website
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need Strict-Transport-Security and other missing security headers on the website for defense in depth.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict-Transport-Security header added: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload
Referrer-Policy header added: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
Permissions-Policy header added: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
Headers configured in Cloudflare _headers file or Astro middleware
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: HSTS header added to _headers file. Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy were already present from PH-008. All three security headers now configured.

previousStories.title: Email confirmation guidance after sign up
previousStories.description: As a new user, I want clear guidance after signing up with email that I need to confirm my email address before I can sign in.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful signUpEmail, AuthView shows a confirmation screen instead of the form
Confirmation screen shows email icon, the email address used, and instructions to check inbox
'Resend Confirmation Email' button available after 60-second cooldown
SupabaseService gains a resendConfirmation(email:) method
'Back to Sign In' button returns to the sign-in form
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: Email confirmation screen after sign-up shows email, instructions, resend button with 60s cooldown. SupabaseService.resendConfirmation() method. Back to Sign In button.
